name: play_emotion
description: Move the robot's head and body to express something physically -- nod yes, shake no, look curious, laugh, look confused, celebrate, greet someone. Use it alongside your spoken answer whenever a gesture would make you feel less like a speaker on a desk: nod when you agree, look confused when a question is unclear, welcome someone who just walked up. The movement runs while you speak, so call it and carry straight on. Do not narrate the gesture; just do it and keep talking.

emotion.description: Plain word for the expression: yes, no, curious, confused, happy, laughing, surprised, proud, sad, tired, welcoming, thanks, sorry, thinking, celebrate, dance. Exact library names like 'curious1' also work.
